/-- `pool_entries_disjoint` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 1; §40). -/
theorem pool_entries_disjoint {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    EntriesDisjoint L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).1

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 2): on every state of a library run
(`PReachI`), an active entry authority designates a live slot at its current generation (§89). -/
theorem pool_no_stale_access {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    NoStale L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).2.1

/-- `pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc`, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 3):
on every state of a library run (`PReachI`), `freeSlot` never succeeds while the companion of a
resolution of the pool, or an active descendant of it, covers the slot (§43, §69). This is not the
contract's statement: `FreeGuarantee` is false on such a state
(`Witness.pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc_false`). -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc_same_pool {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
    (h : PReachI k statics L) : FreeGuaranteeSamePool k L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).2.2

/-- Exclusivity of a `Modify` companion, as the contract states it (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2:
"Une compagne `Modify` active bloque les nouvelles compagnes sur l'intégralité du stockage du pool";
==========
/-- `pool_inv_preserved`, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4): `PoolInvSamePool`
holds on every state of a library run whose steps start from states satisfying `KInv` (§57); with
`PReach.toI`, on every library-reachable state under the guarantee of §57. This is not the
contract's statement: `PoolInv` is false on such a state (`Witness.pool_inv_preserved_false`). -/
theorem pool_inv_preserved_same_pool {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
    (h : PReachI k statics L) : PoolInvSamePool k L :=
  have ⟨_, hwf, hns, _⟩ := pReachI_inv h
  ⟨entriesDisjoint_of hwf, hns, freeGuaranteeSamePool_of hwf⟩

/-- `pool_entries_disjoint` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 1; §40). -/
theorem pool_entries_disjoint {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    EntriesDisjoint L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).1

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 2): on every state of a library run
(`PReachI`), an active entry authority designates a live slot at its current generation (§89). -/
theorem pool_no_stale_access {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    NoStale L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).2.1
==========
/-- An accepted `freeSlot` preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40, §49.7; not a clause
of §57) (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §69 effect). -/
theorem freeSlot_preserves_kAux {k : K} {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (ha : KAux L.kern) (hst : FreeSlotStep k j h L (.ok L')) : KAux L'.kern := by
  obtain ⟨pl, sl, -, -, -, -, -, he, -⟩ := pool_freeSlot_ends_content hst
  rw [he]; exact contentEnd_preserves_kAux ha

/-- `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` under the `Modify` right (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3): on a state
of a library run (`PReachI`) satisfying `KInv` (§57), an accepted `freeSlot` acts on a usable slot
over which the current frame has exercisable `Modify` through `internal` (§69.1), and leaves the
slot usable (§69: "`place` remains usable"; D.3: no deallocation). -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_under_modify {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L L' : PState}
    (hL : PReachI k statics L) (hk : KInv L.kern) {j : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hst : FreeSlotStep k j h L (.ok L')) :
    ∃ pl sl, L.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl ∧
      L.kern.Usable sl.place ∧ HasRight L.kern .modify sl.place ∧
      L'.kern = endUseEff L.kern sl.place ∧ L'.kern.Usable sl.place := by
  obtain ⟨-, hwf, -⟩ := pReachI_inv hL
  obtain ⟨pl, sl, hp, hsl, hR, -, hpre, he, -⟩ := pool_freeSlot_ends_content hst
  have hpl : pl ∈ L.pools := List.mem_of_getElem? hp
  obtain ⟨hu, hright⟩ := freeSlot_modify_right (hwf.pools _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hpl))
    (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := (·.place)) (List.mem_of_getElem? hsl)) hR hpre hk.2.1.2.2
  exact ⟨pl, sl, hp, hsl, hu, hright, he, by rw [he]; exact endUseEff_usable hk.1 hu⟩

/-! ## Rights required by `allocSlot`, `freeSlot`, `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1, D.3) -/

==========
/-- §69.1 under the `Modify` right (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "Il ne s'agit pas de supposer une
invocation de O12 autorisée par simple `MetaRight`"): for a slot of a well-formed pool, `AdminRight`
and the entry clause of `ContentEndPre` give exercisable `Modify` over the slot, through
`internal`, and, under `NoDangling` (§54), its usability. -/
theorem freeSlot_modify_right {k : K} {s : S3} {pl : Pool} {q : Nat} (hok : PoolOK s pl.shape)
    (hq : q ∈ pl.shape.places) (hr : AdminRight s pl) (hpre : ContentEndPre k s q pl.internal)
    (hnd : NoDangling s) : s.Usable q ∧ HasRight s .modify q := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hr.1
  obtain ⟨y', hy', hmy⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hok.internalMode
  have e : y' = y := Option.some.inj (hy'.symm.trans hy)
  subst e
  have hmr := hr.2
  simp only [Arena.MetaRight, Arena.arenaValue, Pool.entry, hy] at hmr
  obtain ⟨v, hv, b, -, hb, hall⟩ : ∃ v, y'.holder = .place v ∧ HasRight s .modify v := by
    revert hmr; cases hh : y'.holder with
    | frame f => simp [OptP]
    | place v => exact fun hm => ⟨v, rfl, hm⟩
  have hex : s.ExercisableAt pl.internal .modify := .held hy ya (.inr hmy) hv hb hall
  have hcov : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ y'.footprint := fun l hl => by
==========
/-- `freeSlot` is not a kernel `endUse` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "Le contrôle n'interprète pas
`internal` comme un emprunt externe"; §69.2): on `w4`, `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` is accepted, while the
kernel `endUse` of slot place 1 is rejected, because `internal` (authority 3, derived, active,
covering place 1) is held by the pool value outside the slot. Both states satisfy `KInv` (§57) and
the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7; not a clause of §57), decided through `Arena.KInvB`. -/
theorem freeSlot_not_endUse :
    (∃ L', FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ w4 (.ok L') ∧ PReachI K0 hst L' ∧
      KInv L'.kern ∧ KAux L'.kern) ∧
      ¬ EndUsePre K0 w4.kern 1 ∧ KInv w4.kern ∧ KAux w4.kern := by
  have hok : FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ w4 (.ok _) :=
    .ok (pl := pl4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
  have hk4 : KInv w4.kern ∧ KAux w4.kern := Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)
  exact ⟨⟨_, hok, .step w4_reach hk4.1 (.freeSlot hok), Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)⟩, by decide,
    hk4⟩

/-- Contract problem (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "Le contenu du slot demeure `Uninit` jusqu'à son
écriture ; l'écriture du handle dans `dst` n'initialise pas le slot"): the preconditions of
`allocSlot` do not exclude a destination inside the allocated slot. On `w3`, `allocSlot(0, 1)` is
accepted on slot 0, whose place is 1: the slot becomes live and its content `Init` (§67). -/
theorem allocSlot_into_own_slot :
==========
/-- Exclusivity of a `Modify` companion, as the contract states it (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2:
"Une compagne `Modify` active bloque les nouvelles compagnes sur l'intégralité du stockage du pool";
non-normative library contract): an active `Modify` companion of a pool is the only active
companion that covers a leaf of that pool's storage (§43, §50). The contract does not restrict the
other companions to the same pool. This property is false on a library-reachable state
(`Witness.pool_resolve_modify_exclusive_false`). -/
def ModifyExclusive (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, ∀ pl ∈ L.pools, r₁.pool = pl.id → L.kern.Active r₁.comp →
    L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify →
    (∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp r₂.comp, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P pl.storage) → r₁.comp = r₂.comp

/-- `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive`, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: "La
propriété d'exclusivité concerne toutes les suites d'opérations admises du noyau"): on every state
of a library run (`PReachI`), whatever its kernel steps, an active `Modify` companion of a pool is
the only active companion of that pool (§43, §50). This is not the contract's statement:
`ModifyExclusive`, which also covers the companions of other pools, is false on such a state
(`Witness.pool_resolve_modify_exclusive_false`). -/
theorem pool_resolve_modify_exclusive_same_pool {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
    (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool → L.kern.Active r₁.comp →
      L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify → r₁.comp = r₂.comp := by
==========
/-- A companion of a ghost resolution exists (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §42). -/
theorem comp_lt {L : PState} (hw : PoolWF L) {r : Res} (hr : r ∈ L.res) :
    r.comp < L.kern.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hc, _⟩ := hw.res r hr
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hc
  exact lt_of_getElem? hy

/-- `NoStale` carries over to a kernel state that reactivates nothing (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4,
item 2; §42). -/
theorem NoStale.kern {L : PState} {s' : S3} (h : NoStale L) (hw : PoolWF L)
    (hA : Arena.AKeep L.kern s') : NoStale { L with kern := s' } :=
  fun r hr e he ha => h r hr e he (hA.active_back ha (entry_lt hw hr he))

/-- `CompExcl` carries over to a kernel state that reactivates nothing (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2)
(§42). -/
theorem CompExcl.kern {L : PState} {s' : S3} (h : CompExcl L) (hw : PoolWF L)
    (hA : Arena.AKeep L.kern s') : CompExcl { L with kern := s' } :=
  fun r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂ => h r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne
    (hA.active_back ha₁ (comp_lt hw hr₁)) (hA.active_back ha₂ (comp_lt hw hr₂))

/-- Two shapes of a list with distinct identities and the same identity are equal
(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §46). -/
theorem eq_of_id : ∀ {l : List PoolShape} {a b : PoolShape}, (l.map (·.id)).Nodup → a ∈ l →
    b ∈ l → a.id = b.id → a = b
==========
/-- Adding a well-formed resolution keeps `PoolWF` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60). -/
theorem poolWF_addRes {L : PState} {s' : S3} {rn : Res} (h : PoolWF L)
    (hA : Arena.AKeep L.kern s') (hf : FpKeep L.kern s')
    (hrn : ResOK s' (L.pools.map Pool.shape) rn) : PoolWF ⟨s', L.pools, L.nId, L.res ++ [rn]⟩ := by
  have h' := h.transport hA hf rfl
  refine ⟨h'.ids, h'.nodup, h'.pools, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hr with hr | hr
  · exact h'.res r hr
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr]; exact hrn

/-- Adding a resolution whose entries designate live slots at their generation keeps `NoStale`
(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 2; §60). -/
theorem noStale_addRes {L : PState} {s' : S3} {rn : Res} (h : NoStale L) (hw : PoolWF L)
    (hA : Arena.AKeep L.kern s')
    (hrn : ∀ e ∈ rn.entries, ∃ pl ∈ L.pools, pl.id = rn.pool ∧
      ∃ sl, pl.slots[e.2.1]? = some sl ∧ sl.gen = e.2.2 ∧ sl.live = true) :
    NoStale ⟨s', L.pools, L.nId, L.res ++ [rn]⟩ := by
  intro r hr e he ha
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hr with hr | hr
  · exact (h.kern hw hA) r hr e he ha
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at he ⊢; exact hrn e he

/-- Authorities after `resolve` (§60 effects; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2): the companion `|A|`,
then the entry authority `|A| + 1` derived from it. -/
theorem resolve_A (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) (R : List Nat) :
    (deriveEff (compS s pl m) s.A.length R m).A = s.A ++
      [⟨m, some pl.internal, footprint s.P pl.storage, .frame s.top, true⟩,
==========
/-- Every library step keeps the ghost invariants (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1–D.4), under `WF3`
and I1 (§49, §50). -/
theorem pstep_inv {k : K} {L L' : PState} (hw : WF3 L.kern) (hi1 : I1 L.kern) (hwf : PoolWF L)
    (hns : NoStale L) (hce : CompExcl L) (h : PStep k L L') :
    PoolWF L' ∧ NoStale L' ∧ CompExcl L' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hs =>
    have hA := Arena.kstep_akeep hs
    exact ⟨hwf.transport hA (fpKeep_kstep hs) rfl, hns.kern hwf hA, hce.kern hwf hA⟩
  | newPool hs => exact pinv_newPool hw hwf hns hce hs
  | allocSlot hs => exact pinv_allocSlot hwf hns hce hs
  | resolve hs => exact pinv_resolve hi1 hwf hns hce hs
  | resolveMany hs => exact pinv_resolveMany hi1 hwf hns hce hs
  | unresolve hs => exact pinv_unresolve (k := k) hwf hns hce hs
  | freeSlot hs => exact pinv_freeSlot hwf hns hce hs

/-- The invariants of library runs (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1–D.4; §57): on every state reached
==========
/-- `PoolInv` as the contract states it (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, as corrected; non-normative
library contract): entry disjointness, `pool_no_stale_access`, and the transition guarantee of
`freeSlot` (§55, §57). It is false on a library-reachable state
(`Witness.pool_inv_preserved_false`). -/
def PoolInv (k : K) (L : PState) : Prop := EntriesDisjoint L ∧ NoStale L ∧ FreeGuarantee k L

/-- Same-pool restriction of `PoolInv` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4; non-normative library
contract): items 1 and 2 as the contract states them, item 3 restricted to the companions of the
slot's pool (`FreeGuaranteeSamePool`). This is not the contract's statement (`PoolInv`) (§55,
§57). -/
def PoolInvSamePool (k : K) (L : PState) : Prop :=
  EntriesDisjoint L ∧ NoStale L ∧ FreeGuaranteeSamePool k L

/-- `EntriesDisjoint` follows from the ghost well-formedness (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 1)
(§40). -/
theorem entriesDisjoint_of {L : PState} (hwf : PoolWF L) : EntriesDisjoint L := by
  intro pl hpl
  have hok := hwf.pools _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hpl)
  exact ⟨fun sl hsl l hl => hok.slotIn sl.place (List.mem_map_of_mem (f := (·.place)) hsl) l hl,
    fun a b sa sb ha hb hab => hok.disjoint a b sa.place sb.place
      (by simp [Pool.shape, ha]) (by simp [Pool.shape, hb]) hab⟩

/-- The same-pool transition guarantee follows from the ghost well-formedness
(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 3, restricted to the slot's pool): an active descendant of a
companion of the pool is younger than `internal`, so it is neither `internal` nor one of its
==========
/-- `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive`, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: "La
propriété d'exclusivité concerne toutes les suites d'opérations admises du noyau"): on every state
of a library run (`PReachI`), whatever its kernel steps, an active `Modify` companion of a pool is
the only active companion of that pool (§43, §50). This is not the contract's statement:
`ModifyExclusive`, which also covers the companions of other pools, is false on such a state
(`Witness.pool_resolve_modify_exclusive_false`). -/
theorem pool_resolve_modify_exclusive_same_pool {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
    (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool → L.kern.Active r₁.comp →
      L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify → r₁.comp = r₂.comp := by
  intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp ha₁ ha₂ hm
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hne => ?_
  have := (pReachI_inv h).2.2.2 r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂
  rw [hm] at this; cases this.1

/-! ## Handle validation: stale, other pool, free slot (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2, D.3; §89) -/

/-- A handle of another pool is not valid (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2, D.3; §89). -/
theorem not_handleOK_other {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} (hid : h.id ≠ pl.id) : ¬ HandleOK pl h :=
  fun ⟨e, _⟩ => hid e

==========
/-- `pool_no_stale_access` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 2): on every state of a library run
(`PReachI`), an active entry authority designates a live slot at its current generation (§89). -/
theorem pool_no_stale_access {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState} (h : PReachI k statics L) :
    NoStale L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).2.1

/-- `pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc`, same-pool restriction (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.4, item 3):
on every state of a library run (`PReachI`), `freeSlot` never succeeds while the companion of a
resolution of the pool, or an active descendant of it, covers the slot (§43, §69). This is not the
contract's statement: `FreeGuarantee` is false on such a state
(`Witness.pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc_false`). -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_no_companion_desc_same_pool {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : PState}
    (h : PReachI k statics L) : FreeGuaranteeSamePool k L :=
  (pool_inv_preserved_same_pool h).2.2

/-- Exclusivity of a `Modify` companion, as the contract states it (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2:
"Une compagne `Modify` active bloque les nouvelles compagnes sur l'intégralité du stockage du pool";
non-normative library contract): an active `Modify` companion of a pool is the only active
companion that covers a leaf of that pool's storage (§43, §50). The contract does not restrict the
other companions to the same pool. This property is false on a library-reachable state
(`Witness.pool_resolve_modify_exclusive_false`). -/
def ModifyExclusive (L : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ r₁ ∈ L.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ L.res, ∀ pl ∈ L.pools, r₁.pool = pl.id → L.kern.Active r₁.comp →
    L.kern.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify →

/-! # Counterexample to `pool_no_stale_access` (and `pool_inv_preserved`) under HandlePool v0.5

Scratch file: a copy of `formal/Ern/Lib/HandlePool.lean` followed by this section. Run from
`formal/` with `~/.elan/bin/lake env lean <this file>`.

Statics (§47): place 0 is the pool storage with leaf children 1 and 2 (`Uninit`); place 3 is the
pool value (`Init`); place 4 is the handle destination; place 5 is a leaf of frame 0 that will hold
the entry authority. Root authorities 0, 1, 2, 3 cover places 0, 3, 4, 5. No client kernel step
has a companion as source or argument: the companion is created by `resolve` in frame 1, held by
frame 1, and dies when frame 1 exits (§73). The entry authority, stored in place 5 of frame 0,
survives and is reanchored to `internal` (§73.4), so it is no longer a descendant of the
companion, and HP5-1's content condition no longer sees it. -/

namespace Ern.Lib.HandlePool.NoStaleCE
open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Lib.HandlePool Examples

def cst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false),
    ((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
/-- `derive(0, [1, 2], Modify)`: `internal` = authority 4. -/
def c1 : PState := { PState.init cst with kern := deriveEff (PState.init cst).kern 0 [1, 2] .modify }
/-- `store(4, 3)`: `internal` held by the pool value 3. -/
def c2 : PState := { c1 with kern := storeEff c1.kern 4 3 }
/-- `newPool(0, 4)`. -/
def c3 : PState := newPoolEff c2 0 4
def pA : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
/-- `allocSlot(0, 4)`: handle ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ written into place 4. -/
def c4 : PState := allocSlotEff c3 0 pA 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 4
def pA4 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
/-- `derive(1, [3], Modify)`: authority 5 over the pool value. -/
def c5 : PState := { c4 with kern := deriveEff c4.kern 1 [3] .modify }
/-- `derive(3, [5], Modify)`: authority 6 over place 5. -/
def c6 : PState := { c5 with kern := deriveEff c5.kern 3 [5] .modify }
/-- `enterFrame([5, 6], [])`: frame 1. -/
def c7 : PState := { c6 with kern := enterEff c6.kern [5, 6] [] }
/-- `resolve(0, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, Modify)` in frame 1: companion 7, entry authority 8 over slot place 1. -/
def c8 : PState := { c7 with
  kern := deriveEff (compS c7.kern pA4 .modify) c7.kern.A.length (footprint c7.kern.P 1) .modify
  res := c7.res ++ [⟨pA4.id, pA4.internal, c7.kern.A.length, .modify,
    [(c7.kern.A.length + 1, 0, 0)]⟩] }
/-- `store(8, 5)`: the entry authority is stored into place 5 of frame 0. -/
def c9 : PState := { c8 with kern := storeEff c8.kern 8 5 }
/-- `exitFrame`: companion 7 dies with frame 1; entry 8 survives, reanchored to `internal` 4. -/
def c10 : PState := { c9 with kern := exitEff c9.kern }
/-- `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` in frame 0. -/
def c11 : PState := freeSlotEff c10 0 pA4 0 ⟨1, 0, true⟩

theorem c11_reach : DDSound K0 ∧ StaticsOK cst ∧ PReach K0 cst c11 := by
  have h3 : PReach K0 cst c3 := .step (.step (.step .init (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
  have h4 : PReach K0 cst c4 := .step h3 (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := pA) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))
  have h7 : PReach K0 cst c7 := .step (.step (.step h4 (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))))
    (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have r8 : ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify c7 (.ok c8) :=
    .ok (pl := pA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
  have h10 : PReach K0 cst c10 := .step (.step (.step h7 (.resolve r8))
    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (.kernel (.exit (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have f11 : FreeSlotStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ c10 (.ok c11) :=
    .ok (pl := pA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
  exact ⟨fun _ _ h => h.elim, by decide, .step h10 (.freeSlot f11)⟩

/-- Shape of the counterexample: before `freeSlot`, the entry authority 8 recorded for slot 0 at
generation 0 is active, `Modify`, covers slot place 1, and its origin is now `internal` 4; the
companion 7 is inactive. After `freeSlot`, slot 0 is free at generation 1 and 8 is still active. -/
theorem c11_shape :
    (⟨0, 4, 7, .modify, [(8, 0, 0)]⟩ : Res) ∈ c10.res ∧
    c10.kern.A[8]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [1], .place 5, true⟩ ∧ ¬ c10.kern.Active 7 ∧
    c11.pools = [⟨0, 0, 4, [⟨1, 1, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩] ∧ c11.kern.Active 8 := by
  decide

theorem c11_not_noStale : ¬ NoStale c11 ∧ ¬ PoolInv c11 := by
  have h : ¬ NoStale c11 := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨pl, hpl, -, sl, hsl, -, hlv⟩ :=
      h ⟨0, 4, 7, .modify, [(8, 0, 0)]⟩ (by decide) (8, 0, 0) (by decide) (by decide)
    rw [c11_shape.2.2.2.1, List.mem_singleton] at hpl
    subst hpl
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hsl
    subst hsl
    cases hlv
  exact ⟨h, fun hi => h hi.2.1⟩

#print axioms c11_reach
#print axioms c11_shape
#print axioms c11_not_noStale
end Ern.Lib.HandlePool.NoStaleCE

/-! # The write of HP5-3 is not the identity on every library-reachable state

Scratch file: a copy of `formal/Ern/Lib/HandlePool.lean` followed by this section. `internal` is
the root authority 1 of the storage place 3, held by its owner, place 0 (§47, RootHeld); place 0
is the pool value, `Init` at `newPool` (§76.5). A part of place 0 (leaf 1) is then transferred to
a local leaf (§63): the pool keeps its administration right while its value has a `Moved` leaf, so
the write of the leaves of the pool value changes the kernel state. -/

namespace Ern.Lib.HandlePool.MetaWriteCE
open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Lib.HandlePool Examples

/-- Place 0 (owner, `Init` leaves 1 and 2), place 3 (storage owned by place 0, `Uninit` leaves 4
and 5), place 6 (`Uninit` leaf of frame 0). Root authorities: 0 (place 0), 1 (place 3, held by
place 0), 2 (place 6). -/
def vst : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true), ((some 0, none, 0), true),
    ((none, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false), ((some 3, some 0, 0), false),
    ((none, none, 0), false)]
def m1 : PState := newPoolEff (PState.init vst) 3 1
def m2 : PState := { m1 with kern := transferEff m1.kern 1 6 }
def pv : Pool := ⟨0, 3, 1, [⟨4, 0, false⟩, ⟨5, 0, false⟩]⟩

theorem meta_write_not_identity :
    StaticsOK vst ∧ PReach K0 vst m2 ∧ m2.pools[0]? = some pv ∧ AdminRight m2.kern pv ∧
    Arena.arenaValue m2.kern pv.entry = some 0 ∧ m2.kern.I 1 = .moved ∧
    write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := by
  have hne : write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0) ≠ m2.kern := fun e => by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun s : S3 => s.I 1) e
    have : (write3Eff m2.kern (footprint m2.kern.P 0)).I 1 = .init := by decide
    have h2 : m2.kern.I 1 = .moved := by decide
    rw [this, h2] at h1; cases h1
  exact ⟨by decide, .step (.step .init (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
    (.kernel (.transfer (Guarded.ok (by decide)))), rfl, by decide, by decide, by decide, hne⟩

#print axioms meta_write_not_identity
end Ern.Lib.HandlePool.MetaWriteCE

5	# DataStack: a library administrative abstraction (contract DS-v2, non-normative)
6	
7	A `DataStack` instance of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`. The spec does not define
8	its contract (Part XIV preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their
9	library abstractions and are not defined here"). The contract formalized here is the library
10	contract **DS-v2**, which is **not normative**: every definition below that encodes a DS-v2 item
11	says so. The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable
12	on the stack value; the abstraction adds no rights to the kernel), §38 and §46 (library state
13	separate from `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (guard over all registries of live
14	administrations) and §58 (outcomes).
15	
16	DS-v2 is DS-v1 with three changes. DS-v1: marks carry the stack identity and a fresh mark
17	identifier; the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks; `rewind m` fails on a dead or foreign
18	mark, rejects if an active authority derived from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, otherwise
19	returns those cells to available and removes `m` and every mark above it; `push` and `grow` use the
20	derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`: its static checks, the availability `fail`, then
21	`split` of `internal` and `store` of the block); `grow` is in place only (same base, extension into
22	the space directly after the block, `fail` otherwise). DS2-1: `mark` requires the administrative
23	right of §36 (`AdminRight`), else `reject`. DS2-2: `grow` stores the new block authority into the
24	place that currently holds the block authority `b`. DS2-3: a dead stack (`internal` inactive)
25	invalidates its marks, so `rewind` of a mark of a dead stack is `fail`, checked with the dead or
26	foreign mark, before the right. Also part of DS-v2: `push` without room is `fail`; `grow` of a `b`
27	that is no block of the stack is `reject`; §76.5 applies to `newStack`; the dead or foreign mark is
28	checked before the right of §36; §36 applies to `rewind`.
29	
30	Every `ok` step of the library is a sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 (`DReach.reachable`), so the
31	abstraction adds no rights to the kernel (§36).
32	-/
33	
34	namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack
35	
36	open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
37	
38	/-! ## Library state (DS-v2; §38, §46, §47) -/
39	
40	/-- A block issued by a stack (DS-v2, non-normative; recorded like the issuances of §46): position
41	`base` of its first cell and number `size` of cells among the ordered cells of the stack, block
42	authority `auth`, destination `dst` that received it (at `push`, or at the `grow` that issued it,
43	DS2-2). -/
44	structure Blk where
45	  base : Nat
46	  size : Nat
47	  auth : Nat
48	  dst : Nat
49	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
50	
51	/-- A mark (DS-v2, non-normative: "marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier";
52	library metadata of an administrative abstraction, §36, §38): the identity of its stack, its fresh
53	identifier, the top of the stack when it was taken. -/
54	structure Mark where
55	  stack : Nat
56	  id : Nat
57	  top : Nat
58	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
59	
60	/-- A stack (DS-v2, non-normative; library state, §38, §46): administered storage, `internal`
61	authority held by the stack value (§36), ordered cells (the leaves of the storage at creation),
62	top (the cells at positions `≥ top` are available), issued blocks (oldest first), and the ordered
63	list of live marks (DS-v2: "the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks"). -/
64	structure Stack where
65	  storage : Nat
66	  internal : Nat
67	  cells : List Nat
68	  top : Nat
69	  blocks : List Blk
70	  marks : List Mark
71	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
72	
73	/-- State of the stack library (DS-v2, non-normative; §38: administrative states of library
74	abstractions are separate from `S₃`): the kernel state, the stack registry (a stack is identified
75	by its index; stacks are never removed) and the next fresh mark identifier. -/
76	structure DState where
77	  kern : S3
78	  stacks : List Stack
79	  fresh : Nat
80	
81	/-- Initial state (§47: the kernel's initial state; the library registry starts empty; DS-v2,
82	non-normative: no mark identifier given out). -/
83	def DState.init (statics : Statics) : DState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0⟩
84	
85	/-- The `n` cells from position `b` of the stack, leaves of the administered storage (§46; DS-v2,
86	non-normative). -/
87	def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n
88	
89	/-- The cells above mark `m` (DS-v2, non-normative, "a cell above m"; reading DS-R1; §46
90	available leaves): the positions from the top of `m` to the current top, those that `rewind m`
91	returns to available. -/
92	def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)
93	
94	/-- The stack seen as an administration entry (§46, §36; DS-v2, non-normative): storage,
95	`internal`, available cells (positions `≥ top`) and issued blocks. Used for `MetaRight` and the
96	static checks of the derived `issue`, which read only the storage and `internal`. -/
97	def Stack.entry (st : Stack) : ArenaEntry :=
98	  ⟨st.storage, st.internal, st.cells.drop st.top,
99	    st.blocks.map fun x => (cellsOf st x.base x.size, x.auth)⟩
100	
101	/-- The block of the stack whose authority is `b` (§46 issuances; DS-v2, non-normative). -/
102	def Stack.block (st : Stack) (b : Nat) : Option Blk := st.blocks.find? fun y => decide (y.auth = b)
103	
104	/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v2, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
105	decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): the stack is live (`internal` is active, §46 read for a
106	stack; DS2-3: a dead stack invalidates its marks), the mark names stack `j` and it belongs to the
107	list of live marks of the stack. -/
108	def LiveMark (s : S3) (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
109	  s.Active st.internal ∧ m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks
110	
111	/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v2). -/
112	instance (s : S3) (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark s j st m) := by
113	  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance
114	
115	/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v2, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
116	stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
117	value, the place holding `internal`. -/
118	def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry
119	
120	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v2). -/
121	instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
122	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
123	
124	/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/
125	
126	/-- The stack registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; DS-v2, non-normative): the
127	`internal` identities of its live stacks. -/
128	def stackInternals (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) : List Nat :=
129	  (stacks.filter fun st => decide (s.Active st.internal)).map (·.internal)
130	
131	/-- Preconditions of `newStack(storage, internal)` (DS-v2, non-normative; §56): those of `newArena`
132	other than its guard (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3, §76.5 and §76.6 read for a stack), and the guard
133	of §56 over the stack registry and every other registry of live administrations `others`. -/
134	structure NewStackPre (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat))
135	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
136	  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, read for a stack (DS-v2). -/
137	  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
138	  /-- §56: no live administration of any registry uses `internal`. -/
139	  guard : Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal
140	
141	/-- Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v2). -/
142	instance (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
143	    Decidable (NewStackPre s stacks others storage internal) :=
144	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
145	    Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal)
146	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
147	
148	/-- Effect of `newStack` (DS-v2, non-normative; §36: registration adds no rights): a stack whose
149	cells are the leaves of the storage, top 0, no block, no mark; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
150	def newStackEff (D : DState) (storage internal : Nat) : DState :=
151	  { D with stacks := D.stacks ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint D.kern.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }
152	
153	/-- `newStack` as a relation (DS-v2, non-normative; §56, §58): `ok` or `reject`. -/
154	def NewStackStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (D : DState) :
155	    Outcome3 DState → Prop :=
156	  Guarded (NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks others storage internal) (newStackEff D storage internal)
157	
158	/-! ## `push` (DS-v2: the derived `issue`, Part XIV, §77) -/
159	
160	/-- Metadata after `push` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
161	cells leave the available part (the top rises by `size`), the block is recorded. -/
162	def pushMeta (st : Stack) (size a dst : Nat) : Stack :=
163	  { st with top := st.top + size, blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, a, dst⟩] }
164	
165	/-- `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v2, non-normative: "push uses the derived issue"): the derived `issue`
166	of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`, on the stack seen as an
167	entry: its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2, with `MetaRight` of §36), then `fail`, the
168	state unchanged, when fewer than `size` cells are left (availability, §77.4; DS-v2, Q11 (a)),
169	then `split` of `internal` on the cells (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into
170	`dst` (O8). -/
171	inductive PushStep (k : K) (j size dst : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
172	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
173	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
174	      ¬ IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
175	  | fail {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
176	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
177	      ¬ st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length → PushStep k j size dst D .fail
178	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
179	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
180	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
181	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern .reject →
182	      PushStep k j size dst D .reject
183	  | store {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
184	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
185	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
186	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
187	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
188	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
189	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
190	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
191	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
192	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
193	      PushStep k j size dst D
194	        (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩)
195	
196	/-! ## `mark` (DS-v2) -/
197	
198	/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v2, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
199	`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
200	def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
201	  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }
202	
203	/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v2, non-normative; §58 outcomes): `reject` on a missing stack; `reject` without
204	the administrative right of §36 (DS2-1); otherwise `ok`, metadata only (no right created, §36), the
205	identifier is fresh. -/
206	inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
207	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
208	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st → MarkStep j D .reject
209	  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → AdminRight D.kern st →
210	      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)
211	
212	/-- `mark_rejects_without_right` (DS-v2, non-normative, DS2-1: `mark` requires `AdminRight` on the
213	stack, else `reject`; §36, §58): on an existing stack without the administrative right of §36,
214	`mark` has the outcome `reject` and no other. -/
215	theorem mark_rejects_without_right {j : Nat} {D : DState} {st : Stack}
216	    (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (ha : ¬ AdminRight D.kern st) :
217	    MarkStep j D .reject ∧ ∀ o, MarkStep j D o → o = .reject := by
218	  refine ⟨.static hst ha, fun o ho => ?_⟩
219	  cases ho with
220	  | noStack => rfl
221	  | static => rfl
222	  | ok h ha' => rw [hst] at h; cases h; exact absurd ha' ha
223	
224	/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v2) -/
225	
226	/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
227	the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
228	top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
229	def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
230	  { st with
231	    top := m.top
232	    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
233	    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }
234	
235	/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v2, non-normative): `reject` on a missing stack; `fail`, the state
236	unchanged, on a dead or foreign mark, a mark of a dead stack included (DS2-3), before the right;
237	`reject` without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells
238	above `m`: `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active authority derived from
239	`internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release` of the derived authority
240	(O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are removed. -/
241	inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
242	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .reject
243	  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark D.kern j st m →
244	      RewindStep k j m D .fail
245	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
246	      ¬ AdminRight D.kern st → RewindStep k j m D .reject
247	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
248	      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
249	  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
250	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
251	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
252	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
253	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
254	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
255	      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)
256	
257	/-- `rewind` has one outcome (§58: a guarded transition has one outcome; DS-v2, non-normative):
258	the cases of `RewindStep` exclude each other, and `split` and `release` are deterministic
259	(`Guarded.det`). With `rewind_ok_iff`, an `ok` rewind is never also `reject` or `fail`. -/
260	theorem RewindStep.det {k : K} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} {D : DState} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 DState}
261	    (h₁ : RewindStep k j m D o₁) (h₂ : RewindStep k j m D o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
262	  cases h₁ with
263	  | noStack h =>
264	    cases h₂ with
265	    | noStack _ => rfl
266	    | dead h' _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
267	    | static _ _ _ => rfl
268	    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
269	    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
270	    | ok h' _ _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
271	  | dead h hl =>
272	    cases h₂ with
273	    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
274	    | dead _ _ => rfl
275	    | static h' hl' _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
276	    | split h' hl' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
277	    | release h' hl' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
278	    | ok h' hl' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
279	  | static h hl ha =>
280	    cases h₂ with
281	    | noStack _ => rfl
282	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
283	    | static _ _ _ => rfl
284	    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
285	    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
286	    | ok h' _ ha' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd ha' ha
287	  | split h hl _ hs =>
288	    cases h₂ with
289	    | noStack _ => rfl
290	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
291	    | static _ _ _ => rfl
292	    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
293	    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
294	    | ok h' _ _ hs' _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'
295	  | release h hl _ hs hr =>
296	    cases h₂ with
297	    | noStack _ => rfl
298	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
299	    | static _ _ _ => rfl
300	    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
301	    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
302	    | ok h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
303	      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'
304	  | ok h hl ha hs hr =>
305	    cases h₂ with
306	    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
307	    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
308	    | static h' _ ha' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd ha ha'
309	    | split h' _ _ hs' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'
310	    | release h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
311	      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'
312	    | ok h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
313	      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'; rfl
314	
315	/-! ## `grow` (DS-v2: in place, the derived `issue`) -/
316	
317	/-- In-place extension (DS-v2, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
318	block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): the block ends at the top, and
319	`extra` available cells follow it. -/
320	def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
321	  x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length
322	
323	/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v2). -/
324	instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
325	  unfold InPlace; infer_instance
326	
327	/-- The grown block (DS-v2, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`,
328	destination `d`, the place that held the authority of the block, DS2-2; an issuance of §46). -/
329	def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a d : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, d⟩
330	
331	/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
332	top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
333	def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a d : Nat) : Stack :=
334	  { st with
335	    top := st.top + extra
336	    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a d else y }
337	
338	/-- The place that holds authority `a`, if a place holds it (§42: holder; DS-v2, non-normative,
339	DS2-2: the destination of `grow` is the place that currently holds the block authority). -/
340	def holderPlace (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Option Nat :=
341	  match s.A[a]? with
342	  | some y => match y.holder with
343	    | .place v => some v
344	    | .frame _ => none
345	  | none => none
346	
347	/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v2, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
348	when `b` is not a block of the stack or `extra` is zero; `release` of `b` (O3); then the derived
349	`issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size `size + extra` into
350	the place `d` that holds `b` when `grow` starts (DS2-2), on the released state: `reject` when no
351	place holds `b` (there is no destination, §77.2; never on library-reachable states,
352	`DReach.grow_holder`), its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state
353	unchanged, unless the extension is in place (DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split`
354	of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new block into `d` (O8). -/
355	inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
356	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
357	  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
358	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
359	  | noExtra {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → extra = 0 →
360	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
361	  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → 0 < extra →
362	      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
363	  | noHolder {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
364	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) → holderPlace D.kern b = none →
365	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
366	  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
367	      st.block b = some x → 0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
368	      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
369	      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d →
370	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject

372	      st.block b = some x → 0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →

375	      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail

378	      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
379	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d → InPlace st x extra →
380	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
381	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject

397	/-! ## Library runs (DS-v2; §36, §56, §57) -/
398	
399	/-- One `ok` step of the stack library (DS-v2, non-normative): a kernel step O1–O16 of
400	non-administrative code, the registry unchanged; `newStack` with the guard of §56 against the other
401	registries `others`; `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`. -/
402	inductive DStep (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
403	  | kernel {D : DState} {s' : S3} : KStep k D.kern s' → DStep k D ⟨s', D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
404	  | newStack {D D' : DState} {others : List (List Nat)} {storage i : Nat} :
405	      NewStackStep others storage i D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
406	  | push {D D' : DState} {j size dst : Nat} : PushStep k j size dst D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
407	  | mark {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} : MarkStep j D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
408	  | rewind {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
409	  | grow {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat} : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
410	
411	/-- States reachable from the initial state by library steps (DS-v2, non-normative; §47). -/
412	inductive DReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : DState → Prop where
413	  | init : DReach k statics (DState.init statics)
414	  | step {D D' : DState} : DReach k statics D → DStep k D D' → DReach k statics D'
415	
416	/-- Finite sequences of library steps (DS-v2, non-normative; §58 `ok` transitions). -/
417	inductive DRun (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
418	  | refl (D : DState) : DRun k D D
419	  | tail {D D' D'' : DState} : DRun k D D' → DStep k D' D'' → DRun k D D''
420	
421	/-- The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no
422	rights to the kernel; Part XIV: `issue` is `split` then `store`, the reset part of `rewind` is
423	`split` then `release`; DS-v2). -/
424	theorem DStep.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D D' : DState}
425	    (hr : Reachable k statics D.kern) (h : DStep k D D') : Reachable k statics D'.kern := by
426	  cases h with
427	  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
428	  | newStack hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hr
429	  | push hs =>
430	    cases hs with
431	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
432	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ _ => exact hr
433	  | rewind hs =>
434	    cases hs with
435	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.release hrl)
436	  | grow hs =>
437	    cases hs with
438	    | ok _ _ _ hrl _ _ _ hsp hst =>
439	      exact .step (.step (.step hr (.release hrl)) (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
440	
441	/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (§36, §57; DS-v2). -/
442	theorem DReach.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
443	    Reachable k statics D.kern := by
444	  induction h with
445	  | init => exact .init
446	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih

518	live, DS2-3), if an active authority derived from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, `rewind m`
519	has the outcome `reject` and no other: either the administrative right of §36 fails, or `split` of
520	`internal` on the cells above `m` is rejected, since `internal` no longer has effective `Modify` on
521	that cell (§43, §61.1). -/
522	theorem rewind_rejects_live_above {k : K} {D : DState} {j : Nat} {st : Stack} {m : Mark}
523	    (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (hm : LiveMark D.kern j st m) {x l : Nat} {y : Authority}
524	    (hy : D.kern.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hx : st.internal ∈ D.kern.ancs x)
525	    (hly : l ∈ y.footprint) (hl : l ∈ above st m) :
526	    RewindStep k j m D .reject ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep k j m D o → o = .reject := by
527	  have hn : ¬ SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [above st m] := fun h =>
528	    no_desc_of_modify hy ya hly hx (h.modifyOn _ (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl)
529	  refine ⟨?_, fun o ho => ?_⟩

531	    · exact .split hst hm ha (.reject hn)
532	    · exact .static hst hm ha
533	  · cases ho with
534	    | noStack => rfl
535	    | dead h hd => rw [hst] at h; cases h; exact absurd hm hd
536	    | static => rfl
537	    | split => rfl
538	    | release => rfl
539	    | ok h _ _ hsp =>

552	      (∀ i, i ≠ j → D'.stacks[i]? = D.stacks[i]?) ∧ D'.kern.I = D.kern.I := by
553	  cases h with
554	  | ok hst₀ _ _ hsp hrl =>

567	`A`. -/
568	def DBound (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x < s.A.length
569	
570	/-- Every kernel step keeps `DBound` (support for DS-v2, non-normative; §60–§75 `ok` effects on
571	`D`, §42): each effect keeps, drops or moves existing anchors, adds an active authority (§64,
572	§65), or replaces an anchor by an element of its origin chain (§73); `A` never shrinks. -/
573	theorem kstep_dBound {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') (hb : DBound s) : DBound s' := by
574	  have hA := kstep_akeep h
575	  suffices H : ∀ q, ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, x < s.A.length from fun q x hx => hA.lt (H q x hx)
576	  cases h with
577	  | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
578	  | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
579	  | release hs =>
580	    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
581	    obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hp.active
582	    rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; intro q z hz
583	    simp only at hz; split at hz
584	    · exact hb q z (List.mem_filter.1 hz).1
585	    · exact hb q z hz
586	  | transfer hs =>
587	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
588	    intro q z hz; simp only [transferEff] at hz; split at hz
589	    · cases hz
590	    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hz with hz | hz
591	      · exact hb q z hz
592	      · simp only [movedTo, List.mem_flatMap] at hz
593	        obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := hz; exact hb r z hr
594	  | depend hs =>
595	    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
596	    intro q z hz; simp only [dependEff] at hz; split at hz
597	    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hz with hz | hz
598	      · exact hb _ z hz
599	      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hz]; obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hp.anchorActive; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
600	    · exact hb q z hz
601	  | enter hs =>
602	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
603	    intro q z hz; simp only [enterEff] at hz; split at hz
604	    · cases hz
605	    · exact hb q z hz
606	  | exit hs =>
607	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
608	    intro q z hz; simp only [exitEff, List.mem_map] at hz
609	    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hz
610	    have hxl := hb q x hx
611	    cases hf : firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) with
612	    | none => exact hxl
613	    | some w =>
614	      rcases List.mem_cons.1 (List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hf) with rfl | hw
615	      · exact hxl
616	      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hw) hxl
617	  | read hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
618	  | write hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
619	  | writeShared hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
620	  | pin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb

625	    · cases hz
626	    · exact hb q z hz
627	  | free hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hb
628	  | alloc hs =>
629	    cases hs with
630	    | ok =>

632	      · cases hz

642	        · exact hb _ z hz

654	/-- Shape of the `internal` authority of every stack (DS-v2, non-normative; §76.2: own mode

656	modes and footprints never change): it exists, has own mode `Modify` and covers every cell. -/
657	def StackShape (D : DState) : Prop :=
658	  ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), D.stacks[i]? = some st →
659	    ∃ y : Authority, D.kern.A[st.internal]? = some y ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧

663	Part XIV: the steps of `push`, `rewind`, `grow` are kernel steps). -/
664	theorem DStep.akeep {k : K} {D D' : DState} (h : DStep k D D') : AKeep D.kern D'.kern := by
665	  cases h with
666	  | kernel hk => exact kstep_akeep hk
667	  | newStack hs =>
668	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact akeep_append (List.append_nil _).symm
669	  | push hs =>
670	    cases hs with
671	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact (kstep_akeep (.split hsp)).trans (kstep_akeep (k := k) (.store hst))
672	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ _ => exact akeep_append (List.append_nil _).symm
673	  | rewind hs =>
674	    cases hs with
675	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl =>
676	      exact (kstep_akeep (.split hsp)).trans (kstep_akeep (k := k) (.release hrl))
677	  | grow hs =>
678	    cases hs with
679	    | ok _ _ _ hrl _ _ _ hsp hst =>
680	      exact ((kstep_akeep (k := k) (.release hrl)).trans (kstep_akeep (.split hsp))).trans
681	        (kstep_akeep (k := k) (.store hst))

684	its cells (DS-v2, non-normative; §42, §46). -/
685	theorem stackShape_keep {D D' : DState} (hA : AKeep D.kern D'.kern) (hw : StackShape D)
686	    (hs : ∀ (i : Nat) (st' : Stack), D'.stacks[i]? = some st' →
687	      ∃ st : Stack, D.stacks[i]? = some st ∧ st'.internal = st.internal ∧ st'.cells = st.cells) :
688	    StackShape D' := by
689	  intro i st' h
690	  obtain ⟨st, hst, hi, hc⟩ := hs i st' h
691	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hm, hf⟩ := hw i st hst
692	  obtain ⟨y', hy', hm', hf', -⟩ := hA _ y hy
693	  exact ⟨y', hi ▸ hy', hm'.trans hm, fun c hc' => hf' ▸ hf c (hc ▸ hc')⟩

695	/-- Replacing stack `j` by a stack with the same `internal` and cells (DS-v2, non-normative; §46
696	metadata updates of `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`). -/
697	theorem set_keeps {l : List Stack} {j : Nat} {st st₀ : Stack} (hst : l[j]? = some st₀)
698	    (hi : st.internal = st₀.internal) (hc : st.cells = st₀.cells) :
699	    ∀ (i : Nat) (st' : Stack), (l.set j st)[i]? = some st' →
700	      ∃ st'' : Stack, l[i]? = some st'' ∧ st'.internal = st''.internal ∧
701	        st'.cells = st''.cells := by
702	  intro i st' h
703	  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
704	  · exact ⟨st₀, hst, hi, hc⟩
705	  · exact ⟨st', h, rfl, rfl⟩

708	§42 afterwards). -/
709	theorem DStep.stackShape {k : K} {D D' : DState} (h : DStep k D D') (hw : StackShape D) :
710	    StackShape D' := by
711	  have hA := h.akeep
712	  cases h with
713	  | kernel => exact stackShape_keep hA hw fun i st' h => ⟨st', h, rfl, rfl⟩
714	  | @newStack _ _ _ int hs =>
715	    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
716	    intro i st' h
717	    rcases getElem?_append_single h with h | rfl
718	    · exact hw i st' h
719	    · have hi := hp.base.internalAuth
720	      cases hy : D.kern.A[int]? with
721	      | none => rw [hy] at hi; exact hi.elim
722	      | some y =>
723	        rw [hy] at hi
724	        refine ⟨y, hy, hi.2, fun c hc => ?_⟩
725	        have := hp.base.fpSup c hc; simpa [S3.afp, hy] using this
726	  | push hs => cases hs with | ok hst => exact stackShape_keep hA hw (set_keeps hst rfl rfl)

731	/-- Every library-reachable state satisfies `StackShape` (DS-v2, non-normative; §47: no stack
732	initially; §76.2, §76.3, §42). -/
733	theorem DReach.stackShape {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
734	    StackShape D := by
735	  induction h with
736	  | init => intro i st h; simp [DState.init] at h
737	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.stackShape ih

741	/-- The block authority issued by `split` of `src` on one region then `store` into `d` (§61, §65
742	`ok` effects; support for DS-v2, Part XIV derived `issue`): of fresh identity `|A|`, an active
743	`Modify` derived from `src` on the region, held by `d`. -/
744	theorem issued_block (s : S3) (src d : Nat) (R : List Nat) :
745	    (storeEff (splitEff s src [R]) s.A.length d).A[s.A.length]? =
746	      some ⟨.modify, some src, R, .place d, true⟩ := by
747	  rw [storeEff_eq (split_block s src R)]
748	  simp only
749	  rw [List.getElem?_set_self (by simp [splitEff])]

751	/-- Every block authority recorded by a stack is held by a place (support for DS-v2,
752	non-normative, DS2-2: `grow` stores into the place that holds the block authority; §42 holders;
753	§65 `ok` effect at `push` and `grow`). -/
754	def BlocksHeld (D : DState) : Prop :=
755	  ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), D.stacks[i]? = some st → ∀ x ∈ st.blocks,
756	    ∃ y, D.kern.A[x.auth]? = some y ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true
757	
758	/-- An authority held by a place stays held by a place (§42, `AKeep`; support for DS-v2). -/
759	theorem placeHeld_keep {s s' : S3} (hA : AKeep s s') {a : Nat}
760	    (h : ∃ y, s.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) :
761	    ∃ y, s'.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true := by
762	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hp⟩ := h
763	  obtain ⟨y', hy', -, -, -, hp', -⟩ := hA a y hy
764	  refine ⟨y', hy', ?_⟩
765	  cases h : y'.holder.isPlace with
766	  | false => rw [hp' h] at hp; cases hp
767	  | true => rfl

769	/-- Every library step keeps `BlocksHeld` (DS-v2, non-normative; §42; §65 `ok` effect: `push` and
770	`grow` store the new block authority into a place). -/
771	theorem DStep.blocksHeld {k : K} {D D' : DState} (h : DStep k D D') (hw : BlocksHeld D) :
772	    BlocksHeld D' := by
773	  have keep : ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), D.stacks[i]? = some st → ∀ x ∈ st.blocks,
774	      ∃ y, D'.kern.A[x.auth]? = some y ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true :=
775	    fun i st hst x hx => placeHeld_keep h.akeep (hw i st hst x hx)
776	  cases h with
777	  | kernel => exact keep
778	  | newStack hs =>
779	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
780	    intro i st h x hx
781	    rcases getElem?_append_single h with h | rfl
782	    · exact keep i st h x hx
783	    · simp at hx
784	  | push hs =>
785	    cases hs with
786	    | @ok st s₁ s₂ hst _ _ hsp hsto =>
787	      intro i st' h x hx
788	      rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
789	      · rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
790	        · exact keep _ st hst x hx
791	        · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hx]
792	          obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
793	          obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
794	          exact ⟨_, issued_block _ _ _ _, rfl⟩
795	      · exact keep i st' h x hx
796	  | mark hs =>
797	    cases hs with
798	    | @ok st hst _ =>
799	      intro i st' h x hx
800	      rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
801	      · exact keep _ st hst x hx
802	      · exact keep i st' h x hx
803	  | rewind hs =>
804	    cases hs with
805	    | @ok st _ _ hst =>
806	      intro i st' h x hx
807	      rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
808	      · exact keep _ st hst x (List.mem_filter.1 hx).1
809	      · exact keep i st' h x hx
810	  | grow hs =>
811	    cases hs with
812	    | @ok st x₀ s₁ s₂ s₃ d hst _ _ _ _ _ _ hsp hsto =>
813	      intro i st' h x hx
814	      rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
815	      · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
816	        by_cases hxy : y.auth = x₀.auth
817	        · simp only [hxy, ↓reduceIte]
818	          obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
819	          obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
820	          exact ⟨_, issued_block _ _ _ _, rfl⟩
821	        · simp only [hxy, ↓reduceIte]
822	          exact keep _ st hst y hy
823	      · exact keep i st' h x hx

825	/-- Every library-reachable state satisfies `BlocksHeld` (DS-v2, non-normative; §47: no stack
826	initially). -/
827	theorem DReach.blocksHeld {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
828	    BlocksHeld D := by
829	  induction h with
830	  | init => intro i st h; simp [DState.init] at h
831	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.blocksHeld ih
832	
833	/-- On library-reachable states a place holds the authority of every block of a stack, so `grow`
834	always has a destination and `GrowStep.noHolder` never applies there (DS-v2, non-normative, DS2-2;
835	§42, §65). -/
836	theorem DReach.grow_holder {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D)
837	    {j b : Nat} {st : Stack} {x : Blk} (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (hx : st.block b = some x) :
838	    ∃ d, holderPlace D.kern b = some d := by
839	  have hxb : x.auth = b := by simpa using List.find?_some hx
840	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hp⟩ := h.blocksHeld j st hst x (List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hx)
841	  rw [hxb] at hy
842	  unfold holderPlace; rw [hy]
843	  cases hh : y.holder with
844	  | place v => exact ⟨v, by simp [hh]⟩
845	  | frame f => rw [hh] at hp; cases hp

847	/-- The authority added by `split` of `src` on one region can be released at once (support for
848	DS-v2, non-normative, `rewind`; §62): it is active, derived, held by the current frame (§62.1,
849	§62.2), has no descendant (§62.3: origins precede, §42) and, under `DBound`, anchors no place
850	(§62.3, §62.4). -/
851	theorem release_after_split {s : S3} {src : Nat} {R : List Nat} (hb : DBound s) :
852	    ReleasePre (splitEff s src [R]) s.A.length := by
853	  have hy₀ := split_block s src R
854	  refine ⟨⟨_, hy₀, rfl⟩, by rw [hy₀]; simp [OptP], by rw [hy₀]; exact rfl,
855	    fun j hj hn => ?_, fun q _ _ hx => absurd (hb q _ hx) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)⟩
856	  have := chain_lt hn
857	  have := List.mem_range.1 hj; simp [splitEff] at this; omega
858	
859	/-- `rewind_ok_iff` (DS-v2, non-normative: "rewind m fails on a dead or foreign mark, rejects if an
860	active authority derived from internal covers a cell above m, otherwise returns those cells to
861	available"; §36; §61.1, §61.3, §62 through Part XIV). On a library-reachable state (`DReach`, a
862	state invariant), for an existing stack, `rewind m` is `ok` exactly when `m` is a live mark of the
863	stack (DS-v2: its stack is live, DS2-3), the administrative right of §36 holds (`AdminRight`,
864	DS-v2, Q27 (a)), and no active authority derived from `internal` covers a cell above `m` (DS-v2).
865	The model has no explicit check of the last condition: it is the effective `Modify` of `internal`
866	required by `split` (§61.1, with the effective mode of §43). The other checks of `split` and
867	`release` never reject there: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and covers the cells
868	(`DReach.stackShape`, §76.2, §76.3), and anchors name existing authorities
869	(`dBound_of_reachable`). With `RewindStep.det`, `ok` is then the only outcome. -/
870	theorem rewind_ok_iff {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (hr : DReach k statics D)
871	    {j : Nat} {st : Stack} (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) {m : Mark} :
872	    (∃ D', RewindStep k j m D (.ok D')) ↔
873	      LiveMark D.kern j st m ∧ AdminRight D.kern st ∧
874	        ∀ (x l : Nat) (y : Authority), D.kern.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
875	          st.internal ∈ D.kern.ancs x → l ∈ y.footprint → l ∉ above st m := by
876	  constructor
877	  · rintro ⟨D', h⟩
878	    cases h with
879	    | ok h hm ha hsp =>
880	      rw [hst] at h; cases h
881	      have hp := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).1
882	      exact ⟨hm, ha, fun x l y hy ya hx hly hl =>
883	        no_desc_of_modify hy ya hly hx (hp.modifyOn _ (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl)⟩
884	  · rintro ⟨hm, ha, hno⟩
885	    obtain ⟨yi, hyi, hmi, hci⟩ := hr.stackShape j st hst
886	    have yia : yi.active = true := by
887	      obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := ha.1; rw [hyi] at hy; cases hy; exact ya
888	    have hab : ∀ l ∈ above st m, l ∈ yi.footprint :=
889	      fun l hl => hci l (List.mem_of_mem_drop (List.mem_of_mem_take hl))
890	    have hmod : ∀ l ∈ above st m, effective D.kern st.internal l = some .modify := by
891	      intro l hl
892	      have hd : descModes D.kern st.internal l = [] := by
893	        apply nil_of_forall_not_mem; intro e he
894	        obtain ⟨x, y, hy, ya, hly, hx, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 he
895	        exact hno x l y hy ya hx hly hl
896	      rw [effective_eq hyi yia (hab l hl), hd]; simp [effOf, hmi]
897	    have hex : D.kern.ExercisableAt st.internal .modify := by
898	      have hmr := ha.2
899	      simp only [MetaRight, arenaValue, Stack.entry, hyi] at hmr
900	      cases hv : yi.holder with
901	      | frame f => rw [hv] at hmr; exact hmr.elim
902	      | place v =>
903	        rw [hv] at hmr
904	        obtain ⟨b, -, hb, hall⟩ := hmr
905	        exact .held hyi yia (.inr hmi) hv hb hall
906	    have hsp : SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [above st m] := by
907	      refine ⟨ha.1, hex, fun r hr p hp => ?_, fun r hr p hp => ?_, List.pairwise_singleton _ _,
908	        fun r hr p hp x _ hd => ?_⟩
909	      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp; exact hmod p hp
910	      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
911	        exact ⟨by simp only [S3.afp, hyi]; exact hab p hp, by rw [hmod p hp]; simp⟩
912	      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
913	        unfold DistribExcl at hd
914	        cases hx : D.kern.A[x]? with
915	        | none => rw [hx] at hd; exact hd
916	        | some y =>
917	          rw [hx] at hd; obtain ⟨ya, hanc, hpy, -⟩ := hd; exact hno x p y hx ya hanc hpy hp
918	    exact ⟨_, .ok hst hm ha (.ok hsp)
919	      (.ok (release_after_split (dBound_of_reachable hr.reachable)))⟩
920	
921	/-! ## Marks are never reused (`mark_no_aba`) -/
922	
923	/-- Well-formed marks (DS-v2, non-normative, "marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark
924	identifier"; support; library metadata, §38): the live marks of stack `i` are pairwise distinct,
925	name stack `i`, and have identifiers already given out. -/
926	def MarksWF (D : DState) : Prop :=
927	  ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), D.stacks[i]? = some st →
928	    st.marks.Nodup ∧ ∀ m ∈ st.marks, m.stack = i ∧ m.id < D.fresh
929	
930	/-- A removed mark (DS-v2, non-normative; support; library metadata, §38): its identifier was
931	given out and it is live in no stack. -/
932	def Gone (D : DState) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
933	  m.id < D.fresh ∧ ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), D.stacks[i]? = some st → m ∉ st.marks
934	
935	/-- The initial state has well-formed marks (DS-v2, §47). -/
936	theorem marksWF_init (statics : Statics) : MarksWF (DState.init statics) := fun i st h => by
937	  simp [DState.init] at h
938	
939	/-- Replacing stack `j` by a stack whose marks are a sublist keeps `MarksWF` when no identifier is
940	taken back (DS-v2; §38 library metadata). -/
941	theorem marksWF_set {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {st st' : Stack} (hw : MarksWF D)
942	    (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (hs : D'.stacks = D.stacks.set j st')
943	    (hsub : st'.marks.Sublist st.marks) (hf : D.fresh ≤ D'.fresh) : MarksWF D' := by
944	  intro i st'' h
945	  rw [hs] at h
946	  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
947	  · exact ⟨(hw _ st hst).1.sublist hsub, fun m hm => by
948	      have := (hw _ st hst).2 m (hsub.subset hm); exact ⟨this.1, by omega⟩⟩
949	  · exact ⟨(hw i st'' h).1, fun m hm => by
950	      have := (hw i st'' h).2 m hm; exact ⟨this.1, by omega⟩⟩
951	
952	/-- Replacing stack `j` by a stack whose marks are a sublist keeps a removed mark removed (DS-v2;
953	§38 library metadata). -/
954	theorem gone_set {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {st st' : Stack} {m : Mark} (hg : Gone D m)
955	    (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (hs : D'.stacks = D.stacks.set j st')
956	    (hsub : ∀ x ∈ st'.marks, x ∈ st.marks) (hf : D.fresh ≤ D'.fresh) : Gone D' m := by
957	  refine ⟨by have := hg.1; omega, fun i st'' h hm => ?_⟩
958	  rw [hs] at h
959	  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
960	  · exact hg.2 _ st hst (hsub m hm)
961	  · exact hg.2 i st'' h hm
962	
963	/-- Every library step keeps `MarksWF` (DS-v2; §38 library metadata). -/
964	theorem DStep.marksWF {k : K} {D D' : DState} (h : DStep k D D') (hw : MarksWF D) :
965	    MarksWF D' := by
966	  cases h with
967	  | kernel => exact hw
968	  | newStack hs =>
969	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
970	    intro i st h
971	    rcases getElem?_append_single h with h | rfl
972	    · exact hw i st h
973	    · exact ⟨List.nodup_nil, fun m hm => by simp at hm⟩
974	  | push hs =>
975	    cases hs with
976	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.Sublist.refl _) (Nat.le_refl _)
977	  | rewind hs =>
978	    cases hs with
979	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.takeWhile_sublist _) (Nat.le_refl _)
980	  | grow hs =>
981	    cases hs with
982	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.Sublist.refl _) (Nat.le_refl _)
983	  | mark hs =>
984	    cases hs with
985	    | @ok st hst _ =>
986	      intro i st' h
987	      rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
988	      · obtain ⟨hnd, hms⟩ := hw _ st hst
989	        refine ⟨List.nodup_append.2 ⟨hnd, List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨by simp, List.nodup_nil⟩,
990	          fun a ha b hb e => ?_⟩, fun m hm => ?_⟩
991	        · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb; subst hb; subst e
992	          exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hms _ ha).2
993	        · rcases List.mem_append.1 hm with hm | hm
994	          · exact ⟨(hms m hm).1, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (hms m hm).2⟩
995	          · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hm; subst hm; exact ⟨rfl, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
996	      · exact ⟨(hw i st' h).1, fun m hm =>
997	          ⟨((hw i st' h).2 m hm).1, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt ((hw i st' h).2 m hm).2⟩⟩
998	
999	/-- Every library-reachable state has well-formed marks (DS-v2; §47 initial state). -/
1000	theorem DReach.marksWF {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
1001	    MarksWF D := by
1002	  induction h with
1003	  | init => exact marksWF_init statics
1004	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.marksWF ih
1005	
1006	/-- Every library step keeps a removed mark removed: identifiers are fresh (DS-v2; §38 library
1007	metadata). -/
1008	theorem DStep.gone {k : K} {D D' : DState} {m : Mark} (h : DStep k D D') (hg : Gone D m) :
1009	    Gone D' m := by
1010	  cases h with
1011	  | kernel => exact hg
1012	  | newStack hs =>
1013	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
1014	    refine ⟨hg.1, fun i st h hm => ?_⟩
1015	    rcases getElem?_append_single h with h | rfl
1016	    · exact hg.2 i st h hm
1017	    · simp at hm
1018	  | push hs => cases hs with | ok hst => exact gone_set hg hst rfl (fun _ h => h) (Nat.le_refl _)
1019	  | rewind hs =>
1020	    cases hs with
1021	    | ok hst => exact gone_set hg hst rfl (fun _ h => List.takeWhile_subset _ h) (Nat.le_refl _)
1022	  | grow hs => cases hs with | ok hst => exact gone_set hg hst rfl (fun _ h => h) (Nat.le_refl _)
1023	  | mark hs =>
1024	    cases hs with
1025	    | @ok st hst _ =>
1026	      refine ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hg.1, fun i st' h hm => ?_⟩
1027	      rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
1028	      · rcases List.mem_append.1 hm with hm | hm
1029	        · exact hg.2 _ st hst hm
1030	        · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hm; rw [hm] at hg; exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ hg.1
1031	      · exact hg.2 i st' h hm
1032	
1033	/-- Every run keeps a removed mark removed (DS-v2; §38 library metadata). -/
1034	theorem DRun.gone {k : K} {D D' : DState} {m : Mark} (h : DRun k D D') (hg : Gone D m) :

1036	  induction h with
1037	  | refl => exact hg
1038	  | tail _ hs ih => exact hs.gone ih
